about: Hash-only index of measured tables and fields that are not in the public tree. Each entry gives the file name, the sha256 of the full private file, its row count and the reason. Rows of a table without a rows list count the points of its digitised curves. The loader (measured.load) reads private files from MEASURED_PRIVATE or data/private/ and raises PrivateTable when one is absent.
